semantics: POSTing to a Sales Office (kind 'B') is the 'Look for customer' flow (bundle addOrder): the response's salesOrder is appended to the panel and money is a DELTA fed to addMoney (negative fee). Displayed contract: 47h duration; cost per customer = floor(AVERAGE_SALARY(345) x salesOffice.salaryModifier(1.7) x Yd(level, skill) x 47 x discount%). Contracts ask for aerospace products (resource kinds 76-84). PUT .../sales-orders/:orderId/ fulfils (consumes units, pays revenue).
